note: The Indian River County Supervisor of Elections offers sample ballots only through a personal voter lookup, so this is built from the Supervisor's candidate filing records and the state judicial candidate list; county and city referenda could not be verified. Not shown, because an official page confirming that the whole county votes on them could not be found: County Commission District 2 (Robert (Robbie) D. Hardingham, Democratic; Jennifer Pippin, Republican; Nicole Paradiso, write-in) and District 4 (Marc Jaffe, Democratic; Deryl Byron Loar, Republican); also Indian River Mosquito Control District Seat 2, Hospital District, Soil and Water Conservation District, and Sebastian Inlet District seats. Not on the November ballot: School Board Districts 1, 2 and 4 (decided in the August primary). The Supervisor's voter guide lists no Vero Beach, Sebastian or Fellsmere municipal election in November 2026. Check your official sample ballot at VoteIndianRiver.gov.
